_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: Overusing the present continuous with state verbs (I am knowing)
mistake.vi: Lạm dụng thì tiếp diễn với động từ trạng thái: "I am knowing"
mistake.l1: Hindi “jaanta hoon / jaan raha hoon” patterns push learners to -ing forms.

segments.text: Don't say, I am knowing him. Say, I know him.
Know, like, and want are about your mind, not actions. So we keep them simple.
Repeat after me. I know him. I like this song.

native.caption: “know” ({m:know}), “like”, “want” जैसे शब्द कोई काम नहीं, मन की स्थिति बताते हैं, इसलिए इनके साथ -ing नहीं लगाते। कहिए “I know him”, “I am knowing him” नहीं। Ama टीचर के बाद दोहराइए और Lexkite ऐप में ग्रामर का अभ्यास कीजिए।

en.caption: Words like “know” ({m:know}), “like” and “want” do not show an action, they show a state of mind, so they don't take -ing. Say “I know him”, not “I am knowing him”. Repeat after teacher Ama and practice grammar in the Lexkite app.
